description:
Detect abuse of certutil, bitsadmin, mshta, msiexec for download/execution

⚠️ NEEDS-REWRITE: Query is generic SQL, needs conversion to Cloud Guard detector condition

dataSourceDetails.query: SELECT "siem_execution_execution_141", "data__json.message" FROM "oci_monitoring_metricexplorer_metrics" WHERE "compartmentId" = '$COMPARTMENT_ID' AND "namespace" = 'OciLoggingService' AND ("data__json.message" LIKE '%living%' OR "data__json.message" LIKE '%off%') AND "value" > 0
dataSourceDetails.originalQuery: SELECT "siem_execution_execution_141", "data__json.message" FROM "oci_monitoring_metricexplorer_metrics" WHERE "compartmentId" = '$COMPARTMENT_ID' AND "namespace" = 'OciLoggingService' AND ("data__json.message" LIKE '%living%' OR "data__json.message" LIKE '%off%') AND "value" > 0
